newsitem.title: USA: Gadzooks sees Q2 shr $0.12 to $0.18.
newsitem.headline: Gadzooks sees Q2 shr $0.12 to $0.18.

text.p: Gadzooks Inc said Thursday its second quarter earnings will range from $0.12 to $0.18 per share versus $0.18 per share a year ago.
Thursday's statement came a day after Gadzooks said its second quarter performance would fall well short of current analysts' estimates of $0.25 per share.

Jerry Szczepanski, chairman and chief executive officer of Gadzooks, said in a press release the company has been marking down and selling the slow-moving merchandise that earlier had contributed to lower-than-expected June sales.
He estimated the impact on quarterly gross margins to be in the range of 200 to 300 basis points.
The company said it is now moving back-to-school merchandise into the stores to increase the sales potential for the remainder of the quarter.

"We view this as a one-time situation that is tied to some of the decisions we had made concerning inventory levels in the stores and specific product selections," Szczepanski said. "As such, we do not anticipate making any changes in store operations going forward, so selling, general and administration expenses are expected to be about the same dollar level as previously budgeted."
